function a(): void;
function a(x: number): void;
function a(x: number | void) { console.log(x); }

function b(): void;
function b(x: number): void;
function b(x: number) { console.log(x); }

function c(): void;
function c(x: number, y: string): void;
function c(x: number | void, y: string | void) { console.log(x, y); }

function d(): void;
function d(x: number, y: string): void;
function d(x: number | void, y: string) { console.log(x, y); }

function f(): void;
function f(x: unknown) { console.log(x); }

function g(): void;
function g(x: any) { console.log(x); }

function h(): void;
function h(x: undefined) { console.log(x); }

a(); b(1); c(); d(1, "s"); f(); g(); h();
